text:
ana: FYI I opened a PR to add a short section on overage grace windows and alerting for pricing docs. includes SDK snippet, curl, and a tiny grafana alert expr. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5518

matt: nice. can we show both the soft-limit behavior and the hard-enforcement example? people get confused about grace windows vs billed overage.

sanjay: add a note that grace windows are per-billing-account and activated only if the customer has "soft_limits" enabled. also clarify when invoices reflect overage (billing run vs realtime).

ana: draft snippets below. kept short:

```python
# SDK v4: query current usage + soft-limit flag
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
state = client.usage.account_status(billing_account_id="bill_123")
print(state)
# -> {"usage_tokens": 123456, "soft_limit_enabled": true, "grace_window_seconds": 86400}
```

```bash
# curl to fetch account status (header explicit)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/bill_123/status
```

ana: grafana alert example (minimal):

```json
{"title":"Overage warning","condition":"sum(rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total{billing_account_id=\"bill_123\"}[1h])) > 10000","for":"10m","labels":{"severity":"warning"}}
```

matt: small nit: in the SDK example show ISO timestamps if you include date ranges. also mention that grace_window_seconds is the TTL before hard enforcement.

sanjay: FAQ bullets to add: 
- "What happens during grace?" -> "Requests continue but customers see warning emails and dashboard banners; overage is billed at per-token rates at invoice time unless they disable soft limits."
- "Will we auto-scale or throttle?" -> "Hard enforcement throttles at the account level after grace_window_seconds if exceeded and if no invoice/commit exists."

leo: tiny tweak to grafana expr: use `increase(...)` for clarity in docs. I'll paste a one-line replacement: `increase(redwood_usage_tokens_total{billing_account_id=\"bill_123\"}[1h]) > 10000`

docs-bot: PR updated: ana pushed 2 commits to docs/overage-grace-alerts at 6135792480  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5518/files

qa-bot: smoke: curl returned 200, SDK call simulated in staging and returned sample shape, grafana alert expr validates in staging grafana.

billing-eng: confirm phrasing: grace windows are per-billing-account, prorated credit behavior unchanged. added a small sentence to PR clarifying invoice timing.

matt: LGTM. I'll approve once CI passes. thanks for the concise examples, that should cut down billing support tickets.

ana: thanks all :rocket:
